abilities.description: Revive a dead ally and heal it for 4d8. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Arise in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Reraise
abilities.description: Death Ward: the next time the ally would drop to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Reraise in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Regen
abilities.description: The target regains 1d4+1 HP at the start of each of its turns for 5 turns. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Regen in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Protect
abilities.description: The target gets +2 AC for 5 turns. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Protect in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Protectja
abilities.description: Protect (+2 AC) on yourself and every ally within 9 m for 5 turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Protectja in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Shell
abilities.description: The target has advantage on saving throws against spells for 5 turns. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Shell in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Shellja
abilities.description: Shell (advantage on saving throws against spells) on yourself and every ally within 9 m for 5 turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Shellja in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Wall
abilities.description: Protect and Shell together on a creature within 18 m for 5 turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Wall in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Esuna
abilities.description: End Poisoned, Blinded, Silenced and Frightened on a creature within 18 m. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Esuna in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Holy
abilities.description: 4d10 radiant damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Holy in Ovelia's Holy Magicks (the same spell as the White Mage's or the Cleric's, learned again here).

abilities.name: Ice Breath
abilities.description: Breathe a cone of freezing air: everything in it takes 2d8 cold damage (Dexterity save against your manoeuvre DC for half). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Exhales freezing breath, dealing ice damage.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: Breathe a cone of flame: 3d6 fire damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Exhales flaming breath, dealing fire damage.

abilities.name: Thunder Breath
abilities.description: Breathe a 12 m line of lightning: 2d8 lightning damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Exhales fulminating breath, dealing lightning damage.

abilities.name: Dragon's Charm
abilities.description: A creature that isn't humanoid (dragons, beasts, monsters) within 18 m makes a Wisdom save or fights on your side for 2 turns; bosses shrug it off. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Persuades a dragon or hydra to become an ally (here any creature that isn't humanoid).

abilities.name: Dragon's Gift
abilities.description: Give of your own life: you lose 1d8 hit points, and an ally within 18 m regains 3d8 hit points and is cured of being poisoned, blinded, frightened and diseased. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Forfeits one's HP to restore HP to a dragon or hydra and remove its ailments (here any ally).

abilities.name: Dragon's Might
abilities.description: An ally within 18 m gets Strength Surge, Magick Surge and Speed Surge for 3 turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Raises a dragon's bravery, speed and attack powers (here any ally).

abilities.name: Dragon's Speed
abilities.description: Warp time for an ally within 18 m: it gets the Time Mage's Quick (an extra action on its next turn). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Lets a dragon's next turn come at once (here any ally).

abilities.name: Holy Breath
abilities.description: Breathe divine power in a wide cone: 6d8 radiant damage (Dexterity save for half). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Exhales breath replete with divine power, dealing holy damage.

abilities.name: Judgment Blade
abilities.description: Holy energy that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 1d8 radiant, and the target makes a Constitution save or is Stopped for 1 turn (bosses shrug it off). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Channels holy energy through one's sword. Attacks distant units with a chance of inflicting Stop.

abilities.name: Cleansing Strike
abilities.description: Holy energy that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 2d8 radiant, and the target makes a Constitution save or is Doomed (it falls when the count ends; bosses shrug it off). Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Channels holy energy through one's sword. Attacks a distant unit with a chance of inflicting Doom.

abilities.name: Northswain's Strike
abilities.description: Holy energy that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 4d8 radiant (FFT's chance of instant KO is left out: it could end scripted boss fights). Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Channels holy energy through one's sword. Attacks a distant unit with a chance of instant KO.

abilities.name: Hallowed Bolt
abilities.description: Holy energy that flies 9 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 2d8 radiant + 2d8 lightning, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is Silenced for 2 turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Channels holy energy through one's sword. Attacks distant units with a chance of inflicting Silence.

abilities.name: Divine Ruination
abilities.description: Holy energy that flies 9 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage + 3d8 radiant, and the target makes a Wisdom save or is Confused for 2 turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Channels holy energy through one's sword. Attacks units in a straight line with a chance of inflicting Confusion.

abilities.name: Crush Armor
abilities.description: A slash that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage and knocks the target's body armour off; it falls to the ground.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Strikes a distant unit and destroys the item on its body.

abilities.name: Crush Helm
abilities.description: A slash that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage and knocks the target's headwear off; it falls to the ground.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Strikes a distant unit and destroys the item on its head.

abilities.name: Crush Weapon
abilities.description: A slash that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage and knocks the target's weapon out of its hand; it falls to the ground. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Strikes a distant unit and destroys its weapon.

abilities.name: Crush Accessory
abilities.description: A slash that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage and knocks one of the target's accessories off (amulet, ring, cloak, gloves or boots); it falls to the ground. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Strikes a distant unit and destroys its accessory.

abilities.name: Shadowblade
abilities.description: A dark slash that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage and heals you for half the damage dealt.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Employs the power of darkness to absorb a distant unit's HP.

abilities.name: Duskblade
abilities.description: A dark slash that flies 6 m: a melee weapon attack against each foe in the line. A hit deals your weapon's damage, gives the target -2 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC for 2 turns and gives you back a level 1 spell slot. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Swordplay: every sword technique. Employs the power of darkness to absorb a distant unit's MP.

abilities.name: Soul Brand
abilities.description: Bonus action. Brand a creature within 18 m for 1 turn: it can't be resisted. If it dies while branded (by anyone's hand), the party devours its soul and learns its forms (Soul Incarnation). No cooldown.
abilities.fft: The Soul Collector's own art (the user's design): marks a foe whose soul is taken at death.

abilities.name: Soul Incarnation
abilities.description: Bonus action, a Wild Shape charge (2 per short rest): take a form from the Soul Codex. Every devoured soul type gives two forms, the creature itself and an FFT monster; 3 and 5 souls of a type make its forms stronger. Your level scales the form.
abilities.fft: Monster forms in the spirit of FFT's monster jobs.

abilities.name: Feral Vigor
abilities.description: +1 maximum hit point per level, in every form and out of it.
abilities.fft: A Soul Collector support (no FFT original).

abilities.name: Deep Reserves
abilities.description: One more Wild Shape charge for Soul Incarnation (or Wild Shape).
abilities.fft: A Soul Collector support (no FFT original).

abilities.name: Water I / Fire I
abilities.description: Two area cantrips, Water I (cold) and Fire I (fire), plus spell-slot versions (pick level 1-6). Pick a spot up to 18 m away: everyone within 1.5 m (allies too) makes a Dexterity save; on a fail they take 1d6 damage (2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 10), and Water I leaves them Wet for 2 turns (Wet: double cold and lightning damage, half fire damage). Spell-slot versions: one more die than the slot level (2d6 at level 1), half damage on a successful save. Known from the start.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Water I / Fire I (0 AP, 8 MP): 1x MND water/fire damage in a small cross.

abilities.name: Earth I / Thunder I
abilities.description: Two area cantrips, Earth I (falling stones, bludgeoning) and Thunder I (lightning), plus spell-slot versions (pick level 1-6). Pick a spot up to 18 m away: everyone within 1.5 m (allies too) makes a Dexterity save; on a fail they take 1d6 damage (2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 10). Spell-slot versions: one more die than the slot level (2d6 at level 1), half damage on a successful save. Thunder hits Wet targets twice as hard.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Earth I / Thunder I (200 AP, 8 MP): 1x MND earth/thunder damage in a small cross.

abilities.name: Smart Casting
abilities.description: Your area abilities from this mod (every job's, including the Chemist's flask bursts) leave out you and your allies, and your area healing and buffs leave out enemies. BG3's own spells are unchanged.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Smart Casting (200 AP): offensive multi-target abilities don't target allies, helpful ones don't target enemies.

abilities.name: Water II / Fire II
abilities.description: Level 1 spell slot (higher slots: +1d6 per level). Water II (cold) and Fire II (fire): everyone within 2 m of a spot up to 18 m away (allies too) takes 3d6 damage, half on a successful Dexterity save; Water II leaves those who fail Wet for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Water II / Fire II (200 AP, 14 MP): 1.5x MND water/fire damage in a small cross.

abilities.name: Return Magic
abilities.description: When an enemy's spell damages you, its caster takes half that damage back as force damage.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Magic (counter, 200 AP): counters an offensive spell by casting a non-elemental version back at the attacker.

abilities.name: Earth II / Thunder II
abilities.description: Level 1 spell slot (higher slots: +1d6 per level). Earth II (bludgeoning) and Thunder II (lightning): everyone within 2 m of a spot up to 18 m away (allies too) takes 3d6 damage, half on a successful Dexterity save.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Earth II / Thunder II (200 AP, 14 MP): 1.5x MND earth/thunder damage in a small cross.

abilities.name: Boon
abilities.description: When you kill an enemy, your next attack roll (weapon or spell attack) before the end of your next turn is a critical hit. Spells with a saving throw can't be critical hits.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Boon (250 AP): after felling an enemy, the next action is a guaranteed critical hit; wears off at the end of the next turn.

abilities.name: Water Locus / Fire Locus
abilities.description: Level 2 spell slot (higher slots: +1d8 per level). A spell attack at one creature up to 18 m away: 4d8 cold (Water Locus, the target is also Wet for 2 turns) or 4d8 fire (Fire Locus).
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Water Locus / Fire Locus (300 AP, 18 MP): 2x MND water/fire damage to one target.

abilities.name: Earth Locus / Thunder Locus
abilities.description: Level 2 spell slot (higher slots: +1d8 per level). A spell attack at one creature up to 18 m away: 4d8 bludgeoning (Earth Locus) or 4d8 lightning (Thunder Locus, twice as hard on a Wet target).
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Earth Locus / Thunder Locus (300 AP, 18 MP): 2x MND earth/thunder damage to one target.

abilities.name: Lacerating Trap
abilities.description: Level 1 spell slot, once per short rest. Hide a trap on the ground up to 4.5 m away. The first enemy that steps on it ends its turn at once and makes a Dexterity saving throw or is Bleeding for 3 turns. The trap lasts until it springs or a long rest. Known from the start.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Lacerating Trap (8 MP): Bleed and end the turn of an enemy that steps on it.

abilities.name: Immobilizing Trap
abilities.description: Level 1 spell slot, once per short rest. Hide a trap on the ground up to 4.5 m away. The first enemy that steps on it ends its turn at once and makes a Dexterity saving throw or can't move for 2 turns. The trap lasts until it springs or a long rest.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Immobilizing Trap (8 MP): Root and end the turn of an enemy that steps on it.

abilities.name: Item Potency
abilities.description: Items you use are twice as potent: the healing of your Chemist potion skills (Potion, Hi-Potion, X-Potion, also their thrown, spell-slot and Patented Usage forms) and of BG3 healing potions you drink or throw is rolled twice; your thrown acid vials, Smokepowder bombs and spore grenades deal their damage twice; your Alchemist's Fire burns twice as long.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Item Potency: items have double the normal potency.

abilities.name: Painful Trap
abilities.description: Level 1 spell slot, once per short rest. Hide a trap on the ground up to 4.5 m away. The first enemy that steps on it loses half of its current hit points (no save) and ends its turn at once. The trap lasts until it springs or a long rest.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Painful Trap (10 MP): damage for 1/2 of current HP and end the turn of an enemy that steps on it.

abilities.name: Quick Fingers
abilities.description: +1 bonus action every turn (like the Thief's Fast Hands).
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Quick Fingers: situational commands (Open, Gather, Climb, Activate...) cost no action.

abilities.name: Alluring Trap
abilities.description: Level 1 spell slot, once per short rest. Hide a trap on the ground up to 4.5 m away. The first enemy that steps on it ends its turn at once and makes a Dexterity saving throw or is Charmed for 3 turns: it fights on your side on its own (you don't control it). Bosses are immune to the charm. The trap lasts until it springs or a long rest.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Alluring Trap (12 MP): Charm and end the turn of an enemy that steps on it.

abilities.name: Critical: Quicken
abilities.description: When damage leaves you at 20% of your hit points or less, you get an extra action on your next turn. Once per short rest. (The same effect as the Time Mage's Critical: Quick.)
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Critical: Quicken: an immediate turn when HP is critical after taking damage.

abilities.name: Critical Expertise
abilities.description: You or an ally within 3 m scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 for 3 turns. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Critical Expertise (6 MP): CRIT Up on the target.

abilities.name: Sales Pitch
abilities.description: You and every ally within 3 m are Hasted for 3 turns (BG3's Haste: an extra action, +2 AC, more movement, then a turn of lethargy). No concentration. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Sales Pitch (12 MP): Haste in a small area around you.

abilities.name: Patented Usage
abilities.description: A menu of the Chemist item skills you have learned (Potion, Hi-Potion, X-Potion, Antidote, Eye Drops, Echo Herbs, Remedy; not Phoenix Down, Ether or Elixir), used on everyone within 3 m of a point up to 4.5 m away (enemies too). Each item once per short rest (X-Potion once per long rest).
abilities.fft: Fell Seal Patented Usage (14 MP): the selected item is used on a small area (not Phoenix Ashes or Mana Stone).

trophies.name: Small Hunting Trophy
trophies.desc: A fang and a scrap of hide from a beast you brought down. Worth a fair price to any merchant.

trophies.name: Fine Hunting Trophy
trophies.desc: Prime fangs and an unmarked pelt from a dangerous beast. Merchants pay well for it.

trophies.name: Grand Hunting Trophy
trophies.desc: The finest parts of a fearsome monster, taken by a master hunter. A collector's prize.
